comments.author: ThatOneGuy
comments.body:
It's really not a bad conclusion to reach, based on those circumstances! I've personally found that, wherever capital cities like London are concerned, specific quests can be very difficult to pull, on account that so many spawn from those locations. I was vastly overqualified to pull Troy (over 100k adventure fame, r12 archaeology), and it still took me a little over 60 QMPs to re-spawn the silly quest after losing its discovery card.

Additionally, the JP wiki (umiol.com) says you need 1595 adventure fame before you can expect this quest to appear, regardless of the other requirements.
